DiscountStrategy.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initializes the object by storing the customer, cart, and optional promotion, then computes and stores the total from the total() method." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> customer </REF>: object "Reference to the customer to be assigned to this object."
        <REF> cart </REF>: object "Cart to be assigned to this object and used for computing the total."
        <REF> promotion </REF>: object "Optional promotion to be assigned to this object; defaults to None."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Assign the customer parameter to the instance attribute self.customer. RESULT self.customer]
            [COMMAND Assign the cart parameter to the instance attribute self.cart. RESULT self.cart]
            [COMMAND Assign the promotion parameter, which defaults to None, to the instance attribute self.promotion. RESULT self.promotion]
            [COMMAND Call the self.total() method and assign its return value to the private instance attribute self.__total. RESULT self.__total]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
DiscountStrategy.total:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Computes the total price of all items in the cart as the sum of each item's quantity times price, stores it in self.__total, and returns that stored value." total]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> total </REF>: numeric "The computed sum of item['quantity'] * item['price'] for every item in self.cart."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Inside the assignment statement, evaluate the generator expression by iterating over each item in self.cart in order and, for each item, calculate item['quantity'] * item['price']. RESULT product_values]
            [COMMAND Pass the generated product values to Python's built-in sum function to compute their arithmetic total; if self.cart is empty, the total is zero. RESULT computed_total]
            [COMMAND Bind the computed_total to the self.__total attribute (name-mangled as self._ClassName__total in the class body). RESULT self.__total]
            [COMMAND Return the value stored in self.__total as the method's return value. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
DiscountStrategy.due:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Computes the amount due by subtracting the promotion discount from the total, using zero as the discount when self.promotion is None." due]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "The object on which due() is invoked; must provide a promotion attribute that is either None or a callable, and a __total attribute containing the total amount."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: number "The total amount minus the applicable promotion discount."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether self.promotion is None and store the boolean result in is_promotion_none. RESULT is_promotion_none]
            [COMMAND In the if branch, when is_promotion_none is true, set discount to 0. RESULT discount]
            [COMMAND Return self.__total - discount. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: When is_promotion_none is false (self.promotion is not None)]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND In the else branch, call self.promotion(self) and set discount to the returned value. RESULT discount]
            [COMMAND Return self.__total - discount. RESULT result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
DiscountStrategy.FidelityPromo:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Computes a fidelity promotion discount equal to 5% of the order total when the customer's fidelity score is at least 1000, otherwise returns 0." FidelityPromo]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> order </REF>: object "Order object that provides a total() method and a customer dictionary containing a numeric 'fidelity' key."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> return_value </REF>: number "Promotion value: 5% of order.total() when order.customer['fidelity'] >= 1000, otherwise constant 0."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Evaluate whether order.customer['fidelity'] is greater than or equal to 1000. RESULT fidelity_check]
            [COMMAND In the true branch, compute order.total() * 0.05 and assign it to promo_value. RESULT promo_value]
            [COMMAND Return promo_value. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: fidelity_check is false]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND In the false branch, assign constant 0 to promo_value. RESULT promo_value]
            [COMMAND Return promo_value. RESULT return_value]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
DiscountStrategy.BulkItemPromo:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Calculates a 10% bulk discount for each cart line item with quantity at least 20 and returns the total discount amount." BulkItemPromo]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> order </REF>: object "The order containing a cart list, where each cart item has 'quantity' and 'price'."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> discount </REF>: number "The total accumulated discount amount."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize discount to 0. RESULT discount]
            [COMMAND For each item in order.cart, iterate over the cart items. RESULT item]
            [COMMAND Within the for loop over order.cart, if item['quantity'] >= 20, add item['quantity'] * item['price'] * 0.1 to discount. RESULT discount]
            [COMMAND After the loop completes, return the accumulated discount. RESULT discount]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
DiscountStrategy.LargeOrderPromo:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Returns 7% of order.total() when the order contains at least 10 distinct products, otherwise returns 0." LargeOrderPromo]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> order </REF>: object "Order object exposing a cart iterable of items with a 'product' key, and a total() method returning a numeric total."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> return_value </REF>: number "The computed discount amount: 7% of order.total() if the cart has at least 10 distinct products, otherwise 0."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Read order.cart and iterate over each item to build a set of item['product'] values, keeping only distinct product identifiers. RESULT distinct_products]
            [COMMAND Evaluate whether len(distinct_products) is greater than or equal to 10. RESULT qualifies]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: qualifies is true]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Evaluate order.total(), multiply the returned total by 0.07, and return the resulting discount amount. RESULT discounted_total]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: qualifies is false]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return 0 as the discount amount. RESULT zero_discount]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
